title: Integrated Power Delivery for 2.5D/3D Heterogeneous Systems
summary: Vertical Power Delivery (VPD) & SiP, package-integrated multiphase IVRs, and holistic circuit-package co-design for AI accelerators and data centers.
focus: Architectures for chiplet systems including high-density Intermediate Bus Converters (IBC) and Point-of-Load (PoL) regulators; multiphase package-integrated regulators and flip-chip PMICs; systematic optimization framework pushing the Pareto frontier of volumetric power density and system efficiency.
contributions: Independently spearheaded end-to-end design, tape-out, and validation of 7 flip-chip PMICs; co-designed and verified 4 additional PMICs with 100% silicon success rate.
Established end-to-end design methodology for flip-chip PMICs and SiP integration targeting reduced iteration cycles for multi-chiplet power delivery networks.
First-authored 3 flagship conference papers at IEEE CICC 2026 and IEEE ESSERC 2026; 2 regular papers in IEEE JSSC on advanced IVR architectures.
relatedPublications: ESSERC 2026 — Mobius 12V-to-1V converter ring for AI servers [C1]
ESSERC 2026 — Resonant-tank converter for vertical power delivery [C2]
JSSC — SCSL volumetric IVR with auxiliary-assisted gain boosting [J2]

title: High-Efficiency Power Conversion & Intelligent Mixed-Signal Control
summary: Hybrid/resonant SC topologies, learning-based control, and SIMO cross-regulation mitigation for compact high-density systems.
focus: Advanced Hybrid/Resonant Switched-Capacitor topologies for soft-switching high-density regulation; circuit-level model/learning-based control and transient-aware algorithms; Single-Inductor Multiple-Output (SIMO) architectures with active cross-regulation suppression.
contributions: Pioneered novel Hybrid/Resonant SC topologies and trajectory-based soft-switching control pushing Pareto frontiers of volumetric power density.
Chip implementation of lightweight learning algorithm into SIMO converter control for dynamic real-time cross-regulation mitigation.
Published 5 first-authored papers in IEEE APEC and IEEE COMPEL.
relatedPublications: APEC 2026 — X-ReLA ReSC with 98.2% peak efficiency [C10]
COMPEL 2026 — GaN buck state-plane analysis; hybrid SC algebraic synthesis [C6, C7]
APEC 2025 — Time-optimal control for unordered SIDO converter [C18]

title: Clocking-Power Co-Design, Dynamic Scaling & Resilient Architectures
summary: Unified power-clock regulation, DVFS/MEP for ULP edge devices, IMC power-timing co-design, and circuit-level side-channel countermeasures.
focus: Instruction-driven adaptive clocking, Unified Voltage-and-Frequency Regulators (UVFRs), and Minimum Energy Point (MEP) tracking; power-timing co-design for In-Memory Computing, voltage-stacked delivery, and WPT; integrated countermeasures for Power Side-Channel Attack.
contributions: Spearheaded instruction-driven proactive clocking and adaptive power management for energy savings and ultra-dynamic transient response.
Led design of unified voltage-and-frequency regulators bridging digital clocking and analog power delivery.
Published 4 first-authored papers including IEEE TCAS-I and IEEE A-SSCC 2022.
relatedPublications: A-SSCC 2022 — Self-clocked TDC-based unified clock and voltage regulator [C24]
